name: MetaTube Server
description: Jellyfin-compatible metadata API with clean genres, bounded image caching and self-hosted API docs.

TOKEN.description: MetaTube API token. Copy this value into the Jellyfin plugin Token setting.

DATA_DIR.description: Temporary SQLite metadata cache on Heroku; dyno restarts may clear it. For persistence, deploy on a platform with a persistent volume. PostgreSQL is not supported.
